data_source: Only allowed N1c K<=4 residual quantiles and permitted A8 K<=4 class ranks
theory_condition: Local linear-Gaussian exact posterior draws with a flat prior on r active directions give E[rho^2]/sigma^2 = 1 - (r/m)*(1-1/kappa). This is not an equality about finite-step native solver output medians.

xp_k.intervention: tau_y=sigma, inner Langevin effective kappa=1; Euler SSE step unchanged
xp_k.conditional_direction: GOOD rho/sigma tends upward if inner precision drives overfitting

xp_k.reason_for_abstention: last output is denoiser estimate, not projected inner iterate

baseline_class_order_predictions.observed_allowed_calibration: G lower residual in 200/205 same-image pairs
baseline_class_order_predictions.prediction_for_new_baseline_replicates: GOOD lower residual in more than 75 percent of within-image G/C pairs, if family and measurement configurations remain stable
baseline_class_order_predictions.nonindependence: Calibration pairs share images and runs; confidence must be image-cluster based

baseline_class_order_predictions.prediction_for_new_baseline_replicates: DAPS and FAST favor GOOD more strongly than SITCOM, with no numerical probability bound due small ORBIT counts

paired_identity: For fixed common noisy observation y, the sign of residual_C^2-residual_G^2 equals the sign of (D_C-D_G)-2(C_C-C_G). For actual y-adapted candidates, do not apply fixed-candidate Gaussian discrimination without qualification.
explicit_abstentions: No signed forecast for native PSNR quality, CONSISTENT share under XP-K, or FAST normalized residual under XP-G.
The flat-subspace sample theory does not identify a native effective rank or guarantee exact stationarity.
No inference from embargoed XP-K or XP-G outcomes.
novelty_scope: Classical Gaussian inverse-problem identities applied as preregistered physical-mechanism diagnostics, not a new solver or new general theorem
